$source_revision._note: Initial seed for issue #97 — covers the species the Bethe-Salpeter (#50) and hydrogenic-Z-scan (#82) campaigns actively cite. Adding species/observables is mechanical follow-up PRs via the refresh-log workflow.

H.description: Hydrogen — atomic hydrogen, 1S/2S/2P/... bound-state QED precision data

2S1/2-2P1/2._note: Classical hydrogen Lamb shift. Original measurement Lamb-Retherford 1947 at ~1000 MHz; CODATA-2018 evaluation derived from Lundeen-Pipkin 1986 and subsequent refinements.

1s2S1/2._note: The 21-cm hydrogen hyperfine line, foundational for radio astronomy. Essen et al. 1957 maser measurement; later refinements push uncertainty to sub-mHz.

1S-2S._note: Parthey-Matveev-Alnis-Bernhardt-Beyer-Hansch et al. 2011 absolute frequency measurement of the H 1S-2S two-photon transition. ~4e-15 fractional uncertainty.

muonic_H.description: Muonic hydrogen — bound state of proton + muon (replaces electron with muon)

2S1/2-2P3/2._note: Pohl et al. 2010 Nature 466, 213. Muonic-hydrogen Lamb-shift measurement that triggered the proton-radius puzzle: yields rp ~ 0.84 fm, ~5 sigma from the electron-spectroscopy / electron-scattering values then in use.

muonium.description: Muonium — bound state of mu+ and e- (electron orbiting an anti-muon, no nucleus)

1s2S1/2._note: Liu et al. 1999 Phys. Rev. Lett. 82, 711. The muonium ground-state hyperfine interval is one of the most precisely measured purely-leptonic bound-state observables; its agreement with theory is a benchmark test of bound-state QED free of nuclear-structure uncertainties.

positronium.description: Positronium — bound state of e+ and e- (pure leptonic, no hadronic uncertainties)

1s_ortho_para._note: Para-ortho splitting of 1S positronium. Ishida-Suehara-Namba et al. 2014 measurement at ~10 ppm. Precision test of bound-state QED in a system free of nuclear contributions.

Si XIV.description: Hydrogenic silicon ion (Si^13+, one electron bound to Z=14 nucleus). Z-scan target of issue #82.

1s2S1/2._note: Sturm-Kohler-Wolf-Werth et al. 2013 Phys. Rev. Lett. 107, 023002 (and follow-ups). Bound-electron g-factor measurement in hydrogenic Si^13+ at fractional uncertainty ~3e-10. Hydrogenic-Z-scan target of issue #82.

Li III.description: Hydrogenic lithium ion (Li^2+, one electron bound to Z=3 nucleus). Issue #78 target.

1s2S1/2._note: Beckert et al. 2007 Phys. Rev. Lett. 98, 233003 (ESR-storage-ring measurement). The hydrogenic Li2+ ground-state hyperfine interval, used as test of bound-state QED + nuclear-structure contributions.

He II.description: Hydrogenic helium ion (He+, one electron bound to Z=2 nucleus).

1s2S1/2._note: Kohler et al. 2016 Phys. Rev. Lett. 117, 053001. Bound-electron g-factor measurement in hydrogenic He+ at fractional uncertainty ~5e-10.
